glosses: to approach, touch, handle, use something (with pronominal adverb or an + accusative)

examples.text: Das sieht aus, als wären Mäuse drangegangen.
examples.translation: It looks as if mice had got to it.
examples.english: It looks as if mice had got to it.

examples.text: Die Katze geht nicht an ihr Fressen dran.
examples.translation: The cat won’t touch its food.
examples.english: The cat won’t touch its food.

examples.text: An meinen Computer kannst du ruhig drangehen.
examples.translation: Feel free to use my computer.
examples.english: Feel free to use my computer.

glosses: to accept a call, to pick up, answer

examples.text: Ich habe ihn angerufen, aber ist nicht drangegangen.
examples.translation: I rang him, but he wouldn’t pick up.
examples.english: I rang him, but he wouldn’t pick up.
